pages.text: Craft an empty map and use it in the area you want to record. Explore to fill the terrain. Mount a map frame on a wall, floor, or ceiling and right-click with the filled map. Adjacent frames in the same plane hide their shared edges.
Right-click with the blank map in the area you want to chart.
Use maps of adjacent areas at the same scale for a wall-sized map.

pages.title: Rotate and Remove
pages.text: Sneak-right-click a filled frame empty-handed to rotate the map by a quarter turn. Right-click with either drill to remove it. If you harvest the frame, the map comes out with its pins intact.
Use the tool on a point of the displayed map to edit a pin.

pages.title: Place Pins
pages.text: Use the Map Tool to name and color a pin. A map holds up to 32 pins. Right-click a pin to read its target. Click it with a $(l:bibliocraft:navigation/waypoint_compass)waypoint compass$(/l) to copy that target.
